_meta.purpose: Offline stand-in for the IDBI Atlas sandbox. Used by src/enrich_bank.py when credentials or endpoints are unavailable.
_meta.warning: EVERY VALUE HERE IS FABRICATED. No real customer, employee or employer is represented. Names, CIFs, account numbers, PANs, VUAs and consent ids are synthetic and structurally plausible only. Third-party bank short codes appear ONLY inside synthetic cross-bank transaction narrations, to exercise the narration parser; no claim is made about any institution. Anything loaded from this file MUST be tagged FIXTURE and badged in the UI.
